title: SAP Signavio Process and Journey Modeling: what's new in the October 2026 release
author: danielafabbrin40
text:
The October 2026 release of SAP Signavio Process Modeler marks a significant step in how you model, govern, and connect process knowledge across the enterprise. At the center is a completely reimagined Process Modeler canvas, built from the ground up with a modern, AI-native modeling experience and deep integration with the SAP Signavio Process Transformation Suite. Alongside it, this release broadens AI access, strengthens process landscape visibility, and lays the structural foundation for your transformation initiatives. 
 From making AI-assisted modeling available as a Base AI capability, a beta MCP server for AI agents, and the stage one release of the Process Atom Central Repository, this release advances both the day-to-day experience of process professionals and the longer-term vision of an intelligent, interconnected process landscape. A new Process Governance Dashboard rounds out the release, giving administrators a consolidated view of workspace health, without manual audits. 
 Here is a summary of what the new October release brings to you: 
 The new SAP Signavio Process Modeler canvas 
 Starting now, the new SAP Signavio Process Modeler canvas is available to all customers, bringing a completely reimagined modeling experience designed for the next generation of process transformation. 
 It was built from the ground up around three core ideas: 
 A modern, intuitive modeling experience that helps users focus on process improvement rather than tooling 
 Embedded AI-native modeling experience where built-in intelligence guides you from the first element to a ready-to-use process model 
 Deep integration with the SAP Signavio Process Transformation Suite, connecting process design with governance, collaboration, and insights for a more actionable view of transformation 

 *Please note that the new canvas is off by default at GA. Administrators must activate it and assign user groups before anyone can see or use it. Find out how in the activation guide handbook. 
 Read the full story in our dedicated blog post . 

 AI-assisted Process Modeler Now Included in Base AI 
 Effective October 5 th 2026, AI-assisted Process Modeler moves from a Premium AI feature to a Base AI capability for all SAP Signavio Process Modeler customers. No AI units required, no activation through SAP for Me. Workspace administrators can enable it directly within SAP Signavio AI Services settings, making it easier than ever to roll out AI-enabled process modeling across the organization. 
 For teams already using the feature, nothing changes in how it works: usage simply no longer consumes AI units. For those exploring it for the first time, AI-assisted Process Modeler lets your users generate process diagrams from text descriptions, images, and tables in just a few clicks, reducing modeling effort and making process documentation more accessible to a broader range of contributors. A fair usage limit is expected to apply at the workspace level. 

 Find out how to activate AI capabilities in your workspace and assign users in this SAP Help Portal post. 

 Turn your process data into a knowledge source for any AI agent with the SAP Signavio MCP Server (Beta) 
 Equip AI agents to answer natural language questions about your processes, build custom use cases on top of your process information, and accelerate AI-driven transformation, all through a standardized MCP (Model Context Protocol) connector that works with the AI tools your teams already use. No custom development. No dedicated connectors. 
 Want to learn how to get started w ith the SAP Signavio MCP server? You can find the step-by-step in our dedicated guide here . 

 Stage One Release of Process Atom Central Repository 
 Process knowledge today is fragmented. Defined in one place, rediscovered in another, and often lost along the way. The Process Atom Central Repository changes that by establishing a single, governed home for Process Atoms: reusable units of process behavior that teams and AI agents can build on together. 
 This Stage One Release delivers the foundational layer, introducing the Process Atom as a structured, entitled object with a central browsable repository and a basic publishing lifecycle. It focuses on establishing the core building block on which governance, AI-assisted authoring, and broader suite capabilities will follow. 

 If you’re interested in learning more about the rest of the new features of the SAP Signavio October release, check out the blog posts below: 
 SAP Signavio October 2026 Release Highlights 
 The new SAP Signavio Process Modeler canvas 
 Process Analysis and Mining 
 New AI capabilities and enhancements 
 Process Transformation Management and Collaboration 
 Process Governance

title: SAP Signavio Ocotber 2026 Product Release - Process Transformation Management and Process Governance
author: janefu
text:
SAP Signavio October 2026 Product Release - Process Transformation Management 
 I'm excited to share the latest innovations for process transformation management and process governance as part of our SAP Signavio October 2026 product release! 
 Fresh off the SAP Transformation Excellence Summit in Berlin, where we explored how organizations can accelerate transformation and turn AI-powered insights into measurable business outcomes, this release brings several exciting innovations to help you do just that. From turning AI-generated recommendations into actionable transformation initiatives to tracking realized business value and continuously enriching initiatives with the latest insights, these enhancements help organizations move faster from insight to execution, keep transformation efforts on track, and demonstrate tangible business impact. 
 Let's take a closer look at what's new! 
 SAP Signavio Process Transformation Manager 
 Turn AI recommendations into action, track realized transformation value, and keep initiatives execution-ready. 
 Turn AI-powered recommendations into actionable transformation initiatives 
 Identifying process improvement opportunities is only the beginning. The real value comes from turning those insights into action. Transformation leads can now use the Process Consulting Agent to create actionable initiatives and supporting insights directly from AI-generated process optimization recommendations. When Process Consultaingn Agent identifies an improvement opportunity, your users can seamlessly turn the recommendation into structured transformation content while preserving the underlying process context, rationale, and supporting findings. This helps you bridge the gap between process analysis and execution planning without the need to manually recreate information. The same also extends to value management. Process Consulting Agent can use relevant findings from SAP Signavio Process Intelligence or user-provided business information to create structured manual value cases, helping teams connect identified improvement opportunities with expected business value. Key benefits include: 
 Accelerate insights to action: Turn AI-generated optimization recommendations into actionable transformation initiatives and insights with less manual effort. 
 Preserve valuable context: Keep supporting process findings, rationale, and recommendations connected to transformation work. 
 Streamline transformation planning: Create structured initiatives and insights directly from AI recommendations, reducing reliance on disconnected documents and manual processes. 
 Build on existing transformation work: Use existing transformation content as context to align new recommendations with ongoing initiatives and reduce duplication. 
 Connect process improvement to business value: Create manual value cases from Process Intelligence findings or user-provided inputs so improvement opportunities can be assessed and prioritized based on expected value. 

 Click here to watch the video demo for this feature 

 Keep transformation initiatives up to date with AI-assisted initiative enricher 
 Transformation doesn't stand still, and neither should your initiatives. As new process insights, business priorities, and improvement opportunities emerge, transformation teams need to continuously adapt their initiatives without duplicating work or starting from scratch. 
 With the new Initiative Enricher for AI-Assisted Transformation Advisory, transformation leads can enhance existing initiatives directly within SAP Signavio Process Transformation Manager. AI analyzes an initiative's existing insights, assets, and tasks, identifies where additional context could improve the recommendations, and proposes relevant new attributes, assets, and tasks. Suggested content is displayed alongside existing information, making it easy to identify what's new and avoid duplication. Importantly, you remain in full control. Every AI-generated suggestion can be individually reviewed and approved before adding to the initiative, ensuring you stay in control and understand where each recommendation comes from. Key benefits include: 
 Continuously strengthen initiatives: Enrich existing initiatives with relevant attributes, assets, and tasks without recreating work already in progress. 
 Identify opportunities for improvement: Receive AI-assisted guidance on missing information and additional context that could strengthen an initiative. 
 Avoid duplication: Compare proposed enhancements with existing initiative content before deciding what to add. 
 Maintain transparency and control: Review and selectively approve AI-generated suggestions, with clear visibility into their sources and attribution. 
 By making it easier to continuously enrich transformation work, this innovation helps you and your teams to keep initiatives relevant, actionable, and execution-ready as business needs evolve. 

 Track realized transformation value and demonstrate measurable business impact 
 Transformation success isn't just about identifying opportunities or estimating potential benefits. It's about demonstrating the value that has actually been achieved. With the latest value tracking and realization feature in SAP Signavio Process Transformation Manager, transformation leads can now capture, monitor, and visualize realized business value alongside expected value throughout the transformation lifecycle. 
 The capability supports both manually created value cases and value cases originating from SAP Signavio Process Intelligence, providing a more consistent approach to tracking business outcomes across transformation initiatives. Realized values can be entered manually or automatically synchronized from source systems where supported, giving teams the flexibility to track outcomes while maintaining transparency into the underlying data. New historical trend visualizations also make it easier to understand how realized value progresses over time, compare results against expected targets, and identify deviations that may require attention. Key benefits include: 
 Demonstrate measurable business impact: Track actual realized value alongside expected value to clearly distinguish planned benefits from achieved outcomes. 
 Enable end-to-end value tracking: Monitor business value from initial opportunity identification through execution to realized results across manual and system-sourced value cases. 
 Visualize value progression: Track historical value trends to understand progress toward targets, identify deviations, and support timely decisions. 
 Simplify value tracking and reporting: Automatically synchronize realized values from Process Insights and Process Intelligence when available, while enabling manual updates when needed. 
 Ensure data transparency and flexibility: Maintain source-system linkage and distinguish synchronized from manually adjusted values for more reliable reporting. 
 Strengthen transformation steering: Equip transformation teams and stakeholders with actionable insights to assess initiative performance, prioritize improvements, and demonstrate transformation success. 
 With this you can now move beyond measuring transformation potential to actually demonstrating tangible business results. 

 Click here to watch the video demo for this feature 

 Manage transformation tasks with greater flexibility and control 
 Successful transformation requires more than well-defined initiatives. It also depends on clear responsibilities, effective collaboration, and the ability to keep execution on track. The enhanced suite tasks experience introduces additional capabilities to help users manage transformation tasks more efficiently across SAP Signavio Process Transformation Suite. With new task attributes, including due dates, as well as enhanced filtering and sorting capabilities, users can better organize their work, identify priorities, and stay on top of upcoming deadlines. More granular access management also provides greater flexibility in controlling who can view or edit individual tasks, helping teams collaborate while maintaining appropriate permissions. Key benefits include: 
 Stay on top of priorities: Set task due dates and use enhanced filtering and sorting capabilities to organize work and manage deadlines. 
 Improve task visibility: Access additional task attributes for a clearer understanding of responsibilities and execution progress. 
 Gain greater control: Manage access at the individual task level with more granular permissions. 
 Support effective collaboration: Enable a more transparent, flexible, and scalable task management experience across transformation initiatives. 

 Click here and here to watch the video demos for this feature 
 Other Enhancements: 
 Beyond these innovations, the October release introduces further improvements to help transformation teams connect strategic objectives, process insights, and execution activities. 
 Visualize relationships between transformation initiatives and objectives: Gain a clearer understanding of how transformation initiatives contribute to strategic business goals with a new visual relationship graph in SAP Signavio Process Transformation Manager. By making connections between initiatives and their associated objectives visible, teams can more easily navigate transformation work, understand strategic alignment, and see how individual initiatives support broader transformation priorities. 
 Convert correction recommendations into transformation insights: Move more seamlessly from process analysis to transformation planning by converting data-driven correction recommendations from SAP Signavio Process Insights into structured insights in SAP Signavio Process Transformation Manager. This enhancement enables transformation leads to preserve important analytical findings and connect them to relevant transformation work, reducing manual effort while maintaining the context behind each recommendation. 

 Continue your transformation journey with SAP Signavio 
 You direct, AI executes. Realize value across your process transformation journey. The October 2026 release brings this vision to life, empowering organizations to accelerate transformation with AI while keeping people in control. From AI-powered recommendations to actionable initiatives and measurable business outcomes, SAP Signavio Process Transformation Manager helps teams move seamlessly from insight to execution and value realization. 
 Want to know what else is coming out as part of this release? Check out our highlight blog for SAP Signavio Process Transformation Suite and find out what else we have coming out this month!

title: Off Neo Partner Bootcamp: Migration Strategies and Tools Hands-on Workshop

text:
Moving from SAP BTP Neo to Cloud Foundry? Let’s make the transition more manageable. 
 Join our Off Neo Partner Bootcamp: Migration Strategies and Tools Hands-on Workshop , a 3-hour practical session designed to help SAP Partners understand the business drivers, timelines, risks, and technical approaches behind customer migrations.

title: Shape the Future of Automatic Clearing in SAP S/4HANA Cloud, public edition
author: katrina_teuffer
text:
If you work with automatic clearing in Finance, there’s a new Customer Engagement Initiative (CEI) you should know about. This initiative is intended for: 
 Accountants in general ledger and accounts payable 
 Finance managers and functional consultants 
 SAP implementation partners working with Finance customers 
 In this structured program, SAP collaborates directly with customers and SAP partners to validate concepts and gather input before building new functionalities. Your feedback shapes real product decisions. 
 What This Initiative Covers 
 The Automatic Clearing in Finance: AI Advisor and Architecture Research initiative focuses on the following areas: 
 An SAP Joule-based advisor that helps Finance teams review and optimize their automatic clearing configuration — starting with GR/IR clearing (Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt) and extending to open-item management in general ledger (GL). 
 Event-based clearing concept validation to explore whether clearing at the point of posting would better align with how Finance teams actually work. 
 Exploration of further AI capabilities in automatic clearing and open-item management — to be defined based on customer input gathered in this initiative. 
 Why It Matters 
 Automatic clearing can be complex to configure and maintain. Your input will directly shape how SAP develops related capabilities. This is your opportunity to influence the design before it's built. We plan to conduct structured video sessions, typically 60–90 minutes per participant. 
 Where to Register 
 Registration Link: Automatic Clearing in Finance: AI Advisor and Architecture Research 
 Customer registration open: October 19, 2026 – November 20, 2026 
 First sessions: Starting December 17, 2026 
 If automatic clearing is part of your daily work, we encourage you to join this initiative and share your experiences and suggestions!
